To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have synthesized magnetic guanidyn-functionalized metal-organice framework nanospheres with multiple affinities sites for efficient enrichment of phosphopeptides, which can enrich phosphopeptides with high efficiency, and the enrichment results can be directly used for phosphopeptide identification.

magnetic guanidinyl-functionalized metal organic framework (MOF)-based nanospheres with multivalent affinity sites composed of inherent Zn-O clusters based on MOAC, and specific recognition groups (amino groups and guanidin groups) were for the 1st time synthesized by a combined strategy of epitaxially grown and post-synthesized modified magnetic amino-derived MOF.
magnetic guanidinyl-functionalized MOF nanospheres (MOF@Zn-Gu) with multi-affinity were prepared and used as a novel magnetic adsorbent for the efficient enrichment of global Phospppeptides.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and synthesis of a novel multi-affinity magnetic MOF with the combination of the inherent metal cluster and the functional groups.
the design and synthesis of a new type of magnetic guanidine-functionalized MOF nanospheres, and their applications in phosphopeptides enrichment.
the synthesis of magnetic guanidine functionalized MOF nanospheres with high affinity for phosphopeptides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the magnetic guanidinium-functionalized metal- organic framework nanospheres with the multi-affinity sites are a novel type of nanomaterials, which can be used for the efficient enrichment of global phosphorylated proteins and peptides.
the multi-affinity sites of the magnetic guanidynyl-functionalized MOF nanospheres provide an effective strategy for the enrichment of global phosphoproteins.
the magnetic guanidyle functionalized metal-organic frameworks nanospheres with multiple affinity sites were synthesized by the combination of epitaxial growing and post-synthesize modification.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the multi-affinity sites of MOF nanospheres were designed for the enrichment of phosphopeptides, and the multi-affinity enrichment mechanism was revealed, and the enrichment performance of phosphopeptides was improved.

the multi-affinity sites of the magnetic guanidyle-functionalized MOFs can be used for the enrichment of phosphopeptides with different amino acid sequences, and they exhibit high selectivity, high sensitivity, high efficiency, and good repeatability for the analysis of phosphopeptides from complex samples.
we developed a new method for the synthesis of multi-affinity sites of MOF nanospheres, and the multi-affinity sites could improve the enrichment efficiency and selectivity of phosphopeptides.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the multi-affinity sites of MOFs could significantly increase the enrichment efficiency of phosphopeptides, which could be a new strategy for the development of MOFs-based phosphopeptide enrichment materials.
we have developed a new type of magnetic MOFs with multi-affinity for phosphopeptides enrichment, which can be used to enrich the global phosphopeptides from complex biological samples.

the magnetic guanidinium-functionalized MOF nanospheres with the multi-affinity sites are promising for efficient enrichment of phosphopeptides from complicated biological samples, which may open up new opportunities for further application of MOF nanospheric materials in the field of phosphoprotein research.
